About.title: About me
About.intro: Colombian Software Engineer working on full-stack architecture, multi-agent systems, and product. This site is the logbook of what I build, what I learn, and what drives me.

mission.title: Build software people actually use
mission.body: My daily work: turning ideas into live product. I design systems that solve real problems — from a B2B pricing engine to electoral fraud detection — with code that survives contact with production.

vision.title: LATAM as a frontier engineering hub
vision.body: Show that from Neiva, Bogotá, Buenos Aires, or CDMX you can build software at the level of any 硅谷 in the world — without giving up cultural context or the speed that comes from being close to the problem.

values.title: Rigor, transparency, and craft
values.body: Atomic commits. Documentation that helps. Tests where they add value. Reviews that teach. I'd rather say 'I don't know' than invent. I measure success in production, not in demos.

ambitions.title: Take Sophia to the next level
ambitions.body: Sophia is my central project: an autonomous multi-agent system orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode over Hermes + dark-memory. I want to take her from prototype to product, with a public UI and open use cases.
